title: Worksheet 3: Keeping Personal Information Private
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Personal information is any detail that could be used to identify a specific person or find out where they live, go to school, or spend time. Examples of personal information include a full name, home address, school name, phone number, birthday, and photos that show a player's face or location. On Roblox, and on any online platform, it is important to never share personal information with other players, even ones who seem friendly or claim to be a similar age. This is because personal information shared online can be saved, copied, or shared further by the person who receives it, and there is no way to fully take it back once it has been sent. Even small pieces of information can add up: for example, mentioning a school's mascot, a sports team, and a town name in separate messages could allow a stranger to figure out exactly where a player goes to school, even if no single message seems dangerous by itself.
